description: Non-material amendments to planning permission reference 25/1862/FUL dated 22/05/26 for 'Demolition of existing building (Class C2) and erection of a three storey (plus lower ground floor) building for use as a care home (Class C2) comprising living accommodation and ancillary communal space with associated access, parking and landscaping.' Amendments include: Reconfiguration of internal layouts across all floor levels including a reduction in total bedroom count from 56 to 52 bedrooms; Addition of enhanced communal amenities and operational support spaces; Introduction of a new pitched roof skylight/lantern above the second-floor lounge area, and rearrangement of the photovoltaic (PV) solar panel layout; Addition of a main entrance canopy, removal of the large vertical front wall sign, which is replaced by an extended living green wall; Refined brick detailing around window surrounds; Enclosure of an approved balcony with glazed windows; relocation of the second-floor balcony with a 1.8m high set-back glass balustrade;  inclusion of a glazed dividing balustrade on the first-floor balcony; and creation of private ground-floor terraces with glazed doors for 5 units: Reconfiguration of external access doors, including an additional access door from the Art Studio to the terrace, along with an updated access ramp and pedestrian pathway integrated within the landscape design.
